fact: The irrigation minister said the ministry, through its main information centre, prepared 27 GIS-based applications, among them canal shifts, canal cleaning, lifting stations and encroachment removal, and a mobile app for canals and drains, with no contractor named.
title: وزير الري: 27 تطبيقا يعتمد على نظم المعلومات الجغرافية لمتابعة مؤشرات الأداء بمختلف جهات الوزارة
